'''Deneba''' was a reddish-orange [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] on the [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]], in the [[Deneba system/Legends|Deneba system]]. It hosted the [[Conclave at Deneba]] in [[3997 BBY]] atop [[Mount Meru (Deneba)|Mount Meru]], which was disrupted by the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]]. The Krath killed [[Arca Jeth]] during their attack. Deneba was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Deneba bush]].

[[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] [[Lo Khan]] stopped here to refuel, meeting [[Luwingo]], an individual he would use as bodyguard from there on out.
